desc: Used in crafting several objects of power, creating Bottled Aura itself is easily automated with a Dispenser.
Simply place a Bottle and Cork in the dispenser and provide a Redstone Pulse. Provided there is sufficient Aura in the area, a bottle of the local Aura type will be produced.

item.name: Aura Bottle / Aura Bottle / Aura Bottle

quests.title: Energy Conversion
desc: Once thought to be entirely separate, the magical energies know as Source, Aura, and FE are in fact all facets of the same energy. By making use of special crystals, it becomes possible to convert between them with ease.

Pulsating Crystals work by absorbing Source from nearby Source Jars and converting it into usable FE. Should the area contain sufficient Aura, it will also be consumed, greatly enhancing the FE generated.

Resonating Crystals, on the other hand, set up an internal resonance with FE, converting it back into Source or Aura. If a Source Jar is near enough, it will send it there. If there is no jar, or if it is 100% full, the Resonating Crystal will instead convert the incoming FE to Aura and diffuse it into the atmosphere.

item.name: Dim Pulsating Crystal / Bright Pulsating Crystal / Iridescent Pulsating Crystal
Dim Resonating Crystal / Bright Resonating Crystal / Iridescent Resonating Crystal

quests.title: Nature's Aura
desc: Nature's Aura is a druidic themed magi-tech mod that uses the omnipresent 'aura' to derive its power.
Be warned, Aura is a limited resource which must be managed and replenished lest the natural order be disturbed. Draining too much can cause dire consequences.

These quests will guide you through the mod, but be sure to refer back to the manual regularly for extra information. Chapters will unlock as you complete these quests and their associated achievements.

quests.title: Ritual of the Forest
quests.subtitle: Tire-toi une bûche
desc: The Ritual of the Forest is the basis for all magic to come. A tree is sacrificed in the center to provide the energy for the ritual.
The items around the outside of the recipe should each be placed into a Wooden Stand; the order is of no consequence and items may be placed manually or by automation.
Once the reagents are ready, place and grow the required sapling. The Gold Powder will be consumed along with the items and tree when the ritual completes.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura for specific instructions on building the ritual.

quests.title: Getting Started: Rituals
quests.subtitle: The threads that bind us
desc: To begin upon the naturalist's path, Brilliant Fiber should be woven into the leaves of trees. There, they’ll transform the leaves to a beautiful golden hue.
Craft one or more Brilliant Fibers and Right-Click them onto any leaves. The effect will spread to nearby leaves, so with careful management, crafting more Brilliant Fibers should not be necessary.
Golden Leaf will drop whenever the fully transformed leaves are broken. Place fresh leaves near the remaining transformed leaves to begin converting them as well.

quests.title: Offering Table
quests.subtitle: Just nod if you can hear me
desc: Upon reaching a high enough skill level, Naturalists may commune directly with the gods, asking boons in exchange for offerings. Do be mindful, however, as the gods are petty at times, no matter what the offering.
Place the offerings in the bowl and then toss down a Spirit of Calling to complete the ritual. The bowl will hold multiple items, with only a single Spirit required for the full batch.

quests.title: Harnessing Aura: Automation
quests.subtitle: The duality of life and death
desc: The Natural Altar is the heart of two ritual practices; one to infuse life into objects and another to infuse death.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura's section on the Natural Altar and the Crimson Altar for a preview of the required structure.
Any type of plank may be used in its construction.

quests.title: Getting Started: Generating Aura
quests.subtitle: Give And Take
desc: The earliest Naturalists are said to have discovered Aura by observing these Ancient Trees. They found their roots grew deep, drawing Aura up from the depths and dispersing it into the environment.
Upon realizing the Aura could be renewed, they set about devising ever more elaborate ways to use and replenish it. Those who pushed it too far, however, paid dearly.
The trees grown from Ancient Saplings serve two primary purposes:
First, they’ll help replenish Aura in the area they’re planted, albeit slowly. As they do, the leaves will die and decay.  Worry not, more effective methods of replenishing the Aura exist.
Second, the wood is particularly useful when it comes to the arcane as it is steeped in the magical energies of Aura. It makes a fine base for many an arcane implement.

quests.title: Transmutation Catalyst
quests.subtitle: To obtain, something equal must be lost
desc: The Transmutation Catalyst augments the Natural and Crimson Altars to allow them to perform further transformations.
Place it on any of the four short pillars surrounding the Altar itself to activate it.

quests.title: Crumbling Catalyst
quests.subtitle: For ivy climbs the crumbling hall
desc: The Crumbling Catalyst augments the Natural and Crimson Altars to allow them to perform further transformations.
Place it on any of the four short pillars surrounding the Altar itself to activate it.

quests.title: Creational Catalyst
quests.subtitle: An explosion of life to match the primordial age
desc: Each Aura generating device is limited to the extent it can replenish Aura. It is possible, however, to push this boundary and flood an area with an over-abundance of Aura.
Place the Creational Catalyst beneath any Aura Generator to remove its generation cap and attain such lushness as has not been observed since the early days of creation.

quests.title: Mystical Magnifier
quests.subtitle: Relax, I'll need some information first
desc: Many devices have a specific range that can only be seen by Right-Clicking on them with a Mystical Magnifier. It's a valuable tool to any natural botanist.

quests.title: Environmental Eye
quests.subtitle: It's still magic even if you know how it's done
desc: Untrained eyes may notice the more overt signs of Aura in an area, subtle glowing lights and lush plant growth.
The Environmental Eye further hones the Naturalist’s vision to grant deeper insights into the Aura infusing the landscape.
Finding an area with higher-than-normal Aura at this stage may be helpful, as some Aura will be consumed in order to create the apparatuses needed to help renew it.

quests.title: Harnessing Aura: Tools of the Trade
quests.subtitle: Geo-caching 101
desc: A portable source of Aura that can be be put to good use with a variety of tools.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura's section on Natural Tools for potential uses.

quests.title: Environmental Ocular
quests.subtitle: Open your eyes, then open your eyes again
desc: An advanced version of the Natural Eye which grants its owner the ability to see ever more precise details of the Aura around them.

quests.title: Aura Trove
quests.subtitle: Thy cup runneth over
desc: Higher capacity than the Aura Cache.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura's section on Natural Tools for potential uses.
Note: These may not fill completely when worn. To get a full charge, or to even automate filling them, they may be placed in a Natural Altar to their maximum capacity.

quests.title: Shifting Sundial
quests.subtitle: From dusk, to dawn
desc: The most powerful of Naturalists have found that when combined with a rare catalyst, the passage of time itself may be manipulated.
This process will rapidly advance time at a great cost of Aura. Be wary not to allow Aura to drop too far!

quests.title: Corporeal Eye
quests.subtitle: A line in the sand
desc: A simple apparatus that helps contain livestock and other animals. Creatures within the range of this block will be unable to step beyond its boundaries.
No Aura is consumed to produce this effect.
The range depends upon strength of the redstone signal it is provided.

quests.title: Altar of Birthing
quests.subtitle: Crossing the threshold
desc: A ritual that harnesses the powers of creation itself, allowing its user to bring forth new life from the barest traces of material.
Once built, simply throw down the reagents atop the altar. If there's enough Aura, the ritual will proceed automatically.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura for specific instructions on building the ritual.

quests.title: Imperceptible Builder
quests.subtitle: Constructive interference
desc: The Imperceptible Builder assists in complicated automation tasks, taking blocks from nearby inventories and placing them down.
Specify where it should place blocks by placing an example in an Item Frame on the Builder itself.
Refer to the Book of Natural Aura for specific instructions.

quests.title: Aura Field Creators
quests.subtitle: Destructive interference
desc: When two Aura Field Creators are linked together, they form a destructive zone between them that rapidly breaks blocks at the cost of some Aura.
To link them, simply Right-Click one, and then the other. Supply a Redstone signal to either of them to enable the system. They'll begin drawing Aura and breaking blocks after a short delay.
An Item Frame can be used to alter their behavior as well:

Note: The Aura Field Creator will use any tool provided in the frame including any enchants or special break properties of the tool. Shears shear leaves, shovels collect snow, Fortune and Silk Touch are respected.

quests.title: Extraneous Firestarter
quests.subtitle: Maxwell's demon, hard at work
desc: When placed upon a Furnace, Blast Furnace, or Smoker, the Extraneous Firestarter will draw in nearby Aura, converting it into heat for smelting and cooking.

While this process is much quicker than burning Coal or other combustible materials, it does come with the drawback that it can drain Aura into dangerous levels. Multiple may even be installed to enhance the effect.

quests.title: Ender Crate
quests.subtitle: Abaddon's gate
desc: The entire Aura field appears to be connected in some fashion, even across dimensions. Though the measurable effects tend to be more localized, some brilliant Naturalist was able to deduce a way to use the subtle ripples in the weave to transfer matter unimaginable distance.

Ender Crates can be assigned to a channel in an Anvil by simultaneously renaming them and combining them with an Eye of Ender. More Crates can be assigned to the same channel at any time by giving them the same name.
Similarly, Ender Oculars may be assigned a channel to allow personal access to the same inventory. Perfect for dropping off the spoils of exploration while far from home.
A small amount of Aura is used every time an item is moved in or out of the crate. Therefore, it is vital that Aura is generated on both sides of the connection.

quests.title: Hopper Enhancement
quests.subtitle: It reaches out nothing answers and it reaches out
desc: When placed atop an Adept’s Hopper or a Vanilla Hopper, the Hopper Enhancement allows the collection of blocks up to seven blocks away. A very useful tool to have in any automated apparatus.
If used with an Adept’s Hopper, any filter set will be respected by the Hopper Enhancement.

quests.title: Adept Hopper
quests.subtitle: Filtering through the morass
desc: One of the few Natural devices that do not consume Aura to function, Adept’s Hoppers are a filterable hopper that moves items slightly faster than a vanilla hopper.
Place an Item Frame on the side and insert any item or block in the frame to set the filter.

quests.title: Esoteric Ecology
quests.subtitle: Do. Or do not. There is no try.
desc: The act of brewing Potions distills the magical energies found in all life down into a compact and portable form. Those same energies may be released again as Aura with the proper apparatus.
The Lingering Absorber will draw in these energies, re-dispersing them as Aura. Simply smash Lingering Potions on the central block and it will take care of the rest.
Potions may be dispensed with a Dispenser, among other things.

quests.title: Effect Powders
quests.subtitle: Dust in the wind
desc: Lush Aura has a variety of side effects which may or may not be desirable at any given time. Powders exist to control when and where these effects occur.
● Barrens - Prevent the formation of grass on Netherrack.
● Steady Growth - The growth of crops, plants, and flowers will no longer be boosted by Aura.
● Fertility - Passive Animals will breed when able.
● No Storage - Your Aura Cache or Trove will not charge in the area.

quests.title: Winter's Calling
quests.subtitle: She sounds like she's in a flurry
desc: When Aura is drawn through this device, it causes the heat in the area to rapidly disperse, dropping localized temperatures and causing snow and ice to form.

quests.title: Eyes in the Dark
quests.subtitle: The eyes have it
desc: Just as Ender Eyes may assist in the location of Strongholds, these assist in the location of other important structures.
● Eye of the Pillager will locate Pillager Outposts.
● Eye of the Blaze will locate Nether Fortresses.
● Eye of the Shulker will locate End Cities.

item.name: Eye of the Pillager / Eye of the Blaze / Eye of the Shulker

quests.title: Redstone Aura Vaporizer
desc: A closed system which prevents any loss of Aura, this small device serves as an excellent timer, releasing a Redstone pulse whenever the Aura within fully evaporates and re-condenses. The more Aura, the longer this process takes.
Right-Click the Aura Vaporizer with bottled Aura to define the time of the clock. Right-Click with an empty hand to retrieve whatever has been previously installed.
Each bottle of sunlight equates to one second of time. One bottle of ghosts, one minute. One bottle of darkness, one hour.

quests.title: Everlasting Spring
desc: While true that Water is easily obtained through other means, an Everlasting Spring provides a convenient place to connect a pipe to supply other machinery.
The Spring provides water at the cost of a small amount of Aura.

quests.title: Lamp of Sanctuary
desc: Keeping hostile creatures away from sensitive contraptions can be quite vital. The last thing anyone needs is a surprise Creeper visit.
For a miniscule upkeep cost, the Lamp of Sanctuary will inhibit natural mob spawns in its area of influence, the range of which is determined by the strength of the Redstone signal it is receiving.

quests.title: Item Distributor
desc: Quite the simple device, but powerful, nonetheless. The Item distributor moves items from the inventory above it and evenly distributes them to the inventories adjacent.

quests.title: Aura Attraction Cart
desc: Though often thought of in terms of gases, it isn’t quite accurate.

In truth, Aura has an attractive force of its own, leading it to clump into regions instead of fully dispersing. This can be exploited by creating a stronger attractive force and dragging large clumps of it from one place to another, effectively moving the Aura to wherever it is needed.

The process isn’t perfect by any means, and Aura will be left behind as the cart moves, reintegrating into the region. Some would even look at this as a positive, as it allows the Aura to be spread out over a large area without necessarily depositing it in a single spot.

quests.title: Occultism
desc: With Occultism, the Otherworld and its denizens are at your beck and call. From the simple Familiars to grant a variety of combat bonuses, to Ore Crushing Spirits for early ore processing and powerful Djinni Miners to gather valuable materials at your behest, Occultism has something for everyone.
The Dictionary of Spirits has everything needed to get started on the path, and acts both as a guide and as a crafting ingredient for obtaining the names of spirits.

quests.title: Getting Started: Ritual Magic
quests.subtitle: Burnin' For You
desc: Thought to be a native plant of the Otherworld gifted by the Spirits ages ago to initiate trade between worlds, Demon’s Dream is a potent fruit with several unique properties that have been used by practitioners throughout the ages.

Eating Demon’s Dream fruit pushes back the veil separating this world and the Otherworld, allowing one to see things for what they truly are. In particular, Otherworld trees tend to present themselves as common Oak in this world but may be harvested for what they are while under the effects of the Demon’s Dream.

Burning the fruit causes a small rift to open into the Otherworld, creating a flame that exists primarily in that Other Place, simply toss it down and light it. This flame will not burn creatures but may be used to transmute or purify certain materials, such as turning Andesite into Otherstone.
Finally, Spirits from the Otherworld adore the taste of this fruit and feeding it to them will help restore their health.
Demon’s Dream Seeds may be obtained from the Farming for Blockheads Market.

quests.title: Summon Foliot Crusher
quests.subtitle: Working up an Apatite
desc: When one operates outside of time, digging through a rock sample to extract every useful bit of material is a trivial task. Increasingly powerful spirits will be able to obtain even greater yields from a given sample.

While they aren’t particularly quick about it, Foliot Crushers are excellent to keep around any mining operation. They may be handed a stack of items by Sneak Right-Clicking them, or they will simply pick up nearby items they can crush. Either way, they’ll drop the crushed material on the ground where it will need to be picked up.

quests.title: Candles
quests.subtitle: Standard Candle
desc: Candles are another item used in most ritual pentacles. They are made from the tallow you get by slaughtering pigs, cows, sheep, and other such animals.
They work as a light source and are also great for decoration!

quests.title: Occult Materials
desc: Communication and Trade with the Otherworld are feasible and safe for the acolyte, though some specialized materials will be required to begin.
Purified Ink is the only known substance suitable for transcribing the names of Spirits for use in ritual magic. Anything else has a strange tendency to fade, as if it would rather not be involved.
Burnt Otherstone and Otherworld Ashes may be combined and purified to form a specialized form of chalk suitable for drawing the ritual circles used in rituals.

quests.title: White Chalk
quests.subtitle: Returning to the Chalk
desc: While found in most known pentacles, White Chalk alone only has limited binding power. Still, it may be used for basic rituals until additional materials may be secured.

quests.title: Golden Chalk
quests.subtitle: All Chalks of Life
desc: Including rare and expensive materials into the Chalk allows it to create a stronger connection with the Otherworld, allowing Spirits to be bound directly into items to enhance them.

quests.title: Purple Chalk
quests.subtitle: ... And The Moon Went With Him
desc: With a strong extra-planar component, Purple Chalk helps bind increasingly powerful Spirits.
Rituals that make use of Purple Chalk are not without risk, however, and some caution would be wise when dealing with some of these Spirits; not all are so amicable to being called to this realm.

quests.title: Red Chalk
quests.subtitle: Culture Chalk
desc: Infused with the very essence of powerful spirits, Red Chalk is used as a final layer of protection in the most powerful of summoning circles.

quests.title: Cross-Dimensional Storage
quests.subtitle: Truly Out of This World
desc: Truly mind-bending magic, the Dimensional Storage Actuator claims a pocket of the Otherworld and makes it accessible from anywhere.
Though it starts out rather small, its capacity may be greatly expanded by adding Stabilizers. Up to six Stabilizers may be added; place them so they are facing the crystal atop the Actuator itself.
The Actuator is accessible manually and via automation such as pipes, hoppers, or an ME Storage Bus.

They may be picked up and moved without concern for their contents; everything will be right where it was left when the Storage Actuator is placed back down. Anything linked to the Actuator, such as Wormholes, will need to be rebound, however.

quests.title: Tier 1 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer
quests.subtitle: Taking the broader view
desc: Storage Stabilizers are used to expand the internal storage of the Storage Actuator’s space by maintaining the integrity of the dimensional pocket.

The Stabilizers themselves may be placed up to five blocks away from the Actuator on each of the cardinal directions. Only one may be active on a side, but all six sides of the Actuator may be used. Ensure they are facing the Crystal atop the Actuator, not the pedestal itself.

Note: Removing a Stabilizer will not cause items in the Actuator to be lost. Instead, if the Actuator’s current storage exceeds its current capacity, it will simply refuse new items. Items may still be extracted, however.

quests.title: Tier 4 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer
quests.subtitle: Expanding horizons
desc: Using the resonant properties of Iesnium to strengthen the stabilization field, these Stabilizers are the most powerful known and expand the Storage Actuator to incredible capacity.

quests.title: Storage Accessor
quests.subtitle: Overstepping boundaries
desc: A small hand-held device that grants the bearer a portable link to the Storage Actuator it is bound to.
Sneak Right-Click it on an Actuator to bind them.

quests.title: Stable Wormhole
quests.subtitle: Bigger on the inside
desc: A portable hole that may be placed anywhere, granting access to the bound Storage Actuator. These are accessible by automation such as pipes or Transporter Foliots, allowing simple long-distance transport of materials.
Sneak Right-Click it on an Actuator to bind them.

quests.title: Soul Gem
quests.subtitle: How Captivating
desc: A minor trinket with powerful implications, the Soul Gem is effectively a small gateway to the Otherworld, allowing one creature to be put into a form of stasis in the Other Place.
Creatures held this way do not experience time and their biological needs are halted entirely.
Right-Click a creature to store it, and Right-Click again on a block to release it.

quests.title: Otherworld Goggles
quests.subtitle: Cautiously Optimistic
desc: Though the Divination Rod is sufficient for locating Iesnium Ore, the process is slow and requires a keen eye. The Spirits of the Otherworld may be employed to make the process somewhat easier, however.

By wearing goggles with lenses infused with an Otherworld Spirit, one gains the ability to see Otherworld materials as they truly are; much like eating a Demon’s Dream, though without the sickening side effects.

quests.title: Iesnium Pickaxe
desc: The Iesnium Pickaxe has the same stats as a normal diamond pickaxe with the added bonus that it is able to mine Iesnium Ore.

quests.title: Crushed End Stone
quests.subtitle: Stairway to the Stars
desc: Summoning the Possessed Endermite allows the budding practitioner to easily access a rare component required for some rituals: End Stone.

True, one could simply pop off to the End to obtain it, but that gateway isn’t always readily available. Instead, a little barter with the Otherworld can have some delivered with only minor complications involved.

quests.title: Skeleton Skulls
quests.subtitle: We'll beheading off, then
desc: Skulls are used for several Ritual Pentacles and obtaining them isn’t always easy. Enlist the assistance of the Otherworld to summon forth a Skeleton with a surplus of skulls.

quests.title: Ender Pearls
quests.subtitle: Black Oyster Occult
desc: Enderpearls are potent objects of alchemical importance. Though they may be retrieved from the rare Enderman that finds itself in our plane, they’re not exactly guaranteed to have one.
The Possessed Enderman, on the other hand, will always drop a few.
Be wary, as this particular ritual can become quite unstable and its multi-dimensional nature has been known to tear rifts in fabric of reality.

quests.title: Dimensional Mineshaft
quests.subtitle: They all have their faults
desc: The Dimensional Mineshaft opens tiny rifts throughout the planes, giving industrious Spirits access to all sorts of precious materials. Materials they’ll gladly share, as they’re unable to access them without assistance.

In order to operate, a Miner lamp must be placed within the Mineshaft. Over time, it will generate materials that may be extracted via any form of automation. The lamps themselves have durability that is spent for each mining cycle they complete. Though they don’t last long, they may be extracted and repaired if desired.

quests.title: Master Miner Marid
quests.subtitle: Try not to take them for Granite
desc: The pinnacle in Spirit based mining, Marids keen sense and patience mean they find ores that lesser Spirits would overlook.

quests.title: Infused Pickaxe
desc: As if it weren’t complicated enough already, what with all the divination and second sight required to locate and see Iesnium Ore, mining it also requires specially attuned tools to prevent it from settling permanently into Netherrack.

Once again, the Spirits will need to be employed, this time in the form of a crystalline Infused Pickaxe. These tools are incredibly fragile and should therefore be reserved for mining Iesnium Ore. Realistically, this pickaxe shouldn’t need to be used more than a handful of times, however, as a far more durable Iesnium Pickaxe may be crafted with the first few ore and used to mine Iesnium in the future.

quests.title: Spirit Attuned Crystal
quests.subtitle: Discordant Resonance
desc: Resonating with Otherworldly energies, these Attuned Crystals are a simple yet effective method of stabilizing rituals, adding one more layer of protection to the practitioner.

quests.title: Sacrificial Bowls
desc: It is common for young practitioners to believe they’re commanding the Spirits, bending them to their will. This is misguided, however. In truth, the Spirits are long lived creatures whose very perception of time differs wildly from our own, short lived as we are.

Better to think of these interactions as trade. Giving something rare from our world in exchange for a drop from the sea of their time. Even a long-lived practitioner will, after all, perish long before the Spirits they’ve bonded with.

Therefore, when performing these rituals, something of value must be exchanged. The items should be laid out in Sacrificial Bowls prior to the start of the Ritual. Ordinary Sacrificial Bowls may be placed anywhere within eight blocks of the Golden Sacrificial Bowl, even outside the Pentacle. Likewise, the items may be placed into any bowl, the order does not matter.

The item for the Golden Sacrificial Bowl must be placed last; this will trigger the ritual if everything else is correctly placed. If the ritual demands the sacrifice of a creature or use of an item, these actions are to be performed after the ritual is activated and must be performed within eight blocks of the Golden Sacrificial Bowl.

quests.title: Weather Rituals
quests.subtitle: Blossoming even as we gaze
desc: Certain spirits have the ability to control the weather in our world.
Summoning the appropriate Spirit can bring clear skies, make it rain, or even bring on a thunderstorm!

quests.title: Celestial Rituals
quests.subtitle: Swiftly flow the days
desc: For timeless beings such as the Otherworld Spirits, there is little distinction between Past and Present. They are aware of our perception of time, but for them the difference is closer to our perception of Up and Down; moving to another place in time is as simple for them as for us to climb a hill.
Summon a Djinni to advance Day to Night and Night to Day.

quests.title: Afrit Essence
quests.subtitle: Dominance and Submission
desc: A potent binding agent primarily used in the manufacture of Red Chalk, Afrit Essence may only be obtained by besting an Afrit in Combat, which requires summoning said Afrit in a broken Pentacle that leaves the practitioner unprotected and at the mercy of these powerful foes.
Note: Gathering Essence from an Afrit is not always possible. A weapon enchanted with Looting is recommended to increase the odds of harvesting this potent material.

quests.title: Wither Skeleton Skulls
quests.subtitle: Getting ahead in life
desc: The Wild Hunt’s Horns strike fear into the hearts of most who hear its call, knowing that suffering and death soon follow in their wake. Intentionally calling them forth to do battle would be foolhardy at best.
The Spirits of the Otherworld are more than happy to assist in the endeavor, however, for those who believe themselves capable of surviving the onslaught.
This Ritual guarantees multiple Wither Skeleton Skulls and may even result in other special rewards to those who best the Hunt.

quests.title: Getting Started: Iesnium Ore
desc: The strange material dubbed Iesnium has been known to seep into the Nether from the Otherworld. Early alchemists were hesitant to even declare it a metal as, despite its hardness and malleability, it always appears as if it is flowing slowly.

Finding Iesnium is no trivial undertaking, first and foremost requiring travel to the hellish plane of the Nether. It forms in tiny, scattered pockets throughout the land there and obscures itself as the native Netherrack.

Though other methods have been devised, perhaps the simplest method of locating the ore is through divination. A Divination Rod may be attuned to Iesnium by Sneak Right-Clicking it on ordinary Netherrack. Once attuned, hold Right-Click to use the Rod to highlight nearby Iesnium Ore masquerading as Netherrack.

quests.title: Summon Foliot Transporting Spirit
quests.subtitle: Keep on truckin'
desc: Once a common sight around any practitioner’s workshop, Foliot Transporters are quick and intelligent, and will keep items stocked where needed.

Use the Book of Calling that comes with the Spirit to set where to Extract and Deposit. Sneak Right-Click the book on a Spirit to bind them. The Book of Calling may also be used to transport the Spirit.
Sneak Right-Click the Spirit to access a GUI where filters may be set.

quests.title: Summon Djinni Machine Operator
quests.subtitle: I Better Be Gettin' Overtime For This...
desc: The Djinni Machine Operator Spirit is used with the Dimensional Storage Actuator as a basic form of autocrafting.
Use the Book of Calling to bind the Spirit to a machine, then use it again to set which side to have the Spirit push items to and pull items from. Finally, assign the Djinni to a Storage Actuator.

In the Storage Actuator, select a stack of items for the Spirit to process and put it in the slot on the left of the GUI. This will bring up a menu where a Machine Operator may be selected. Doing so will trigger that Operator to collect the items and process them at their machine.

quests.title: Familiar Ring
quests.subtitle: Shoulda put a ring on it
desc: Some Familiars lend themselves more to combat situations than others. For those that grant simple bonuses, it is sometimes preferred to keep them in a ring where they can safely provide their bonus without the risk of catching a stray arrow.
Right-Click any Familiar to store it in the ring. Wearing it will grant any passive bonuses imparted by the Familiar.
The ring is also useful for trading Familiars with other practitioners, as the Familiar will view whoever releases them from the ring as their new companion.

quests.title: Summon Marid Crusher
quests.subtitle: Good at mining their own business
desc: Though rarely seen, Marid are known to be incredibly patient and meticulous, extracting even the finest of particles of material.

quests.title: Summon Foliot Janitor
quests.subtitle: My job. Toilets 'n boilers, boilers 'n toilets. Plus that one boilin' toilet. Fire me if'n you dare.
desc: The Foliot Janitor pairs nicely with Crusher Spirits, or anything else that likes to dump things all over the ground. It will quickly retrieve items and deposit them into a specified inventory or Stable Wormhole.

Use the Book of Calling that comes with the Spirit to set its Work Area and where to Deposit. Sneak Right-Click the book on a Spirit to bind them. The Book of Calling may also be used to transport the Spirit.
Sneak Right-Click the Spirit to access a GUI where filters may be set.

quests.title: Familiars
desc: By sacrificing a life to the Otherworld, some truly magnificent friends may be called forth, granting permanent boons or even fighting alongside their master until their corporeal form can no longer maintain itself and the Spirit slips back to the Other Place.
Though not exhaustive, the list below highlights some of the benefits to be had by befriending the Spirits. More than one may be called forth at a time.
For full details on these and other Familiars, refer to the Dictionary of Spirits under Familiar Rituals.
Combat
● Mummy – Fights for you.
● Beholder – Shoots magical beams.
Utility
● Guardian – A walking Totem of Undying.
● Greedy – Collects items like a magnet.
● Beaver – Helps break wood faster.
Buffs
● Drikwing – Grants multi jump, jump boost, and slow fall.
● Dragon – Increases XP gains.
● Bat – Grants Night Vision.
● Cthulhu – Grants Water Breathing.
● Deer – Grants Jump Boost.
● Devil – Grants Fire Resistance.
Other
● Blacksmith – Repairs equipment and applies upgrades to other familiars, enhancing them in a multitude of ways.
Note: Familiars are protected from friendly fire, and as such it is generally safe to fight near them.

quests.title: Ghast Tears
quests.subtitle: The Great Ghastly
desc: For a creature that spends most of its time wailing, Ghast Tears are seemingly in short supply. With the assistance of the Otherworld, however, a perfectly teary eyed Ghast may be brought forth.

quests.title: Tools and Utility
desc: From material processing and automated mining to celestial manipulation, Occultism has a great deal of utility to provide. Explore some of the options in the following quests.

quests.title: Storage and Logistics
desc: Occultism has a lot to offer in terms of storage and item logistics. The following quests will cover a few of the more notable features.

quests.title: Occultism
desc: With Occultism, the Otherworld and its denizens are at your beck and call. From the simple Familiars to grant a variety of combat bonuses, to Ore Crushing Spirits for early ore processing and powerful Djinni Miners to gather valuable materials at your behest, Occultism has something for everyone.
The Dictionary of Spirits has everything needed to get started on the path, and acts both as a guide and as a crafting ingredient for obtaining the names of spirits.

quests.title: Getting Started: Ritual Magic
quests.subtitle: Burnin' For You
desc: Thought to be a native plant of the Otherworld gifted by the Spirits ages ago to initiate trade between worlds, Demon’s Dream is a potent fruit with several unique properties that have been used by practitioners throughout the ages.

Eating Demon’s Dream fruit pushes back the veil separating this world and the Otherworld, allowing one to see things for what they truly are. In particular, Otherworld trees tend to present themselves as common Oak in this world but may be harvested for what they are while under the effects of the Demon’s Dream.

Burning the fruit causes a small rift to open into the Otherworld, creating a flame that exists primarily in that Other Place, simply toss it down and light it. This flame will not burn creatures but may be used to transmute or purify certain materials.
Finally, Spirits from the Otherworld adore the taste of this fruit and feeding it to them will help restore their health.
Fires can be started with Fire Charges as well as Flint and Steel.

quests.title: Candles
quests.subtitle: Standard Candle
desc: Candles are another item used in most ritual pentacles. Any type of candle will suffice.

quests.title: Occult Materials
desc: Communication and Trade with the Otherworld are feasible and safe for the acolyte, though some specialized materials will be required to begin.
Purified Ink is the only known substance suitable for transcribing the names of Spirits for use in ritual magic. Anything else has a strange tendency to fade, as if it would rather not be involved.

quests.title: White Chalk
quests.subtitle: Returning to the Chalk
desc: While found in most known pentacles, White Chalk alone only has limited binding power. Still, it may be used for basic rituals until additional materials may be secured.

quests.title: Golden Chalk
quests.subtitle: All Chalks of Life
desc: Including rare and expensive materials into the Chalk allows it to create a stronger connection with the Otherworld, allowing Spirits to be bound directly into items to enhance them.

quests.title: Purple Chalk
quests.subtitle: ... And The Moon Went With Him
desc: With a strong extra-planar component, Purple Chalk helps bind increasingly powerful Spirits.
Rituals that make use of Purple Chalk are not without risk, however, and some caution would be wise when dealing with some of these Spirits; not all are so amicable to being called to this realm.

quests.title: Red Chalk
quests.subtitle: Culture Chalk
desc: Infused with the very essence of powerful spirits, Red Chalk is used as a final layer of protection in the most powerful of summoning circles.

quests.title: Cross-Dimensional Storage
quests.subtitle: Truly Out of This World
desc: Truly mind-bending magic, the Dimensional Storage Actuator claims a pocket of the Otherworld and makes it accessible from anywhere.
Though it starts out rather small, its capacity may be greatly expanded by adding Stabilizers. Up to six Stabilizers may be added; place them so they are facing the crystal atop the Actuator itself.
The Actuator is accessible manually and via automation such as pipes, hoppers, or an ME Storage Bus.

They may be picked up and moved without concern for their contents; everything will be right where it was left when the Storage Actuator is placed back down. Anything linked to the Actuator, such as Wormholes, will need to be rebound, however.

quests.title: Tier 1 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer
quests.subtitle: Taking the broader view
desc: Storage Stabilizers are used to expand the internal storage of the Storage Actuator’s space by maintaining the integrity of the dimensional pocket.

The Stabilizers themselves may be placed up to five blocks away from the Actuator on each of the cardinal directions. Only one may be active on a side, but all six sides of the Actuator may be used. Ensure they are facing the Crystal atop the Actuator, not the pedestal itself.

Note: Removing a Stabilizer will not cause items in the Actuator to be lost. Instead, if the Actuator’s current storage exceeds its current capacity, it will simply refuse new items. Items may still be extracted, however.

quests.title: Tier 4 Dimensional Storage Stabilizer
quests.subtitle: Expanding horizons
desc: Using the resonant properties of Iesnium to strengthen the stabilization field, these Stabilizers are the most powerful known and expand the Storage Actuator to incredible capacity.

quests.title: Storage Accessor
quests.subtitle: Overstepping boundaries
desc: A small hand-held device that grants the bearer a portable link to the Storage Actuator it is bound to.
Sneak Right-Click it on an Actuator to bind them.

quests.title: Stable Wormhole
quests.subtitle: Bigger on the inside
desc: A portable hole that may be placed anywhere, granting access to the bound Storage Actuator. These are accessible by automation such as pipes or Transporter Foliots, allowing simple long-distance transport of materials.
Sneak Right-Click it on an Actuator to bind them.

quests.title: Soul Gem
quests.subtitle: How Captivating
desc: A minor trinket with powerful implications, the Soul Gem is effectively a small gateway to the Otherworld, allowing one creature to be put into a form of stasis in the Other Place.
Creatures held this way do not experience time and their biological needs are halted entirely.
Right-Click a creature to store it, and Right-Click again on a block to release it.

quests.title: Crushed End Stone
quests.subtitle: Stairway to the Stars
desc: Summoning the Possessed Endermite allows the budding practitioner to easily access a rare component required for some rituals: End Stone.

True, one could simply pop off to the End to obtain it, but that gateway isn’t always readily available. Instead, a little barter with the Otherworld can have some delivered with only minor complications involved.

quests.title: Skeleton Skulls
quests.subtitle: We'll beheading off, then
desc: Skulls are used for several Ritual Pentacles and obtaining them isn’t always easy. Enlist the assistance of the Otherworld to summon forth a Skeleton with a surplus of skulls.

quests.title: Ender Pearls
quests.subtitle: Black Oyster Occult
desc: Enderpearls are potent objects of alchemical importance. Though they may be retrieved from the rare Enderman that finds itself in our plane, they’re not exactly guaranteed to have one.
The Possessed Enderman, on the other hand, will always drop a few.
Be wary, as this particular ritual can become quite unstable and its multi-dimensional nature has been known to tear rifts in fabric of reality.

quests.title: Spirit Attuned Crystal
quests.subtitle: Discordant Resonance
desc: Resonating with Otherworldly energies, these Attuned Crystals are a simple yet effective method of stabilizing rituals, adding one more layer of protection to the practitioner.
